nodes.name: Retaliation
nodes.description:
Iron Skin no longer grants a Barrier. Instead you reflect Iron Shrapnel when attacked, dealing {payload:UPGRADE_C_SHRAPNEL_TOOLTIP} damage and inflicting {dot:UPGRADE_C_BLEED_DOT} Bleeding damage over {buffduration:UPGRADE_C_BLEED_DOT} seconds.

Iron Skin's duration is tripled.

nodes.name: Duration Bonus
nodes.description: Rallying Cry's duration is increased to {SF_48} seconds.

nodes.name: Fortify
nodes.description: Rallying Cry Fortifies you for [SF_43*100|%|] of your Maximum Life when cast.

nodes.name: Fury Gain
nodes.description: For every {SF_44} meter traveled while Rallying Cry is active, restore [{SF_41}] primary resource to yourself and half to nearby allies.

nodes.name: Potency
nodes.description: Rallying Cry's effectiveness is increased by [{SF_42}*100|%|] plus an additional [{SF_51}*100|%|] for each ally affected, up to [SF_51*SF_54*100|%|].

nodes.name: Movement Speed
nodes.description: Iron Skin increases your Movement Speed by [{SF_32}*100|x%|].

nodes.name: Weaken
nodes.description: Enemies attacking you while Iron Skin is active become Weakened for [{SF_31}] seconds.

nodes.name: Resolve
nodes.description: Iron Skin grants [{SF_36}] stacks of Resolve when cast.

nodes.name: Maximum Life
nodes.description: Increase the Maximum Life granted from Iron Skin to [{SF_14}*(1+{SF_33})*100|%|].

nodes.name: Raging
nodes.description:
Challenging Shout causes enemies to burn with rage, dealing {dot:UPGRADEC_BURNING} Burning damage over {buffduration:UPGRADEC_BURNING} seconds.

You no longer gain Damage Reduction from Challenging Shout but instead gain [{SF_32}*100|x%|] increased damage against Burning enemies.

nodes.name: Damage Bonus
nodes.description: The first {SF_33} enemies Taunted by Challenging Shout take [{SF_34}*100|x%|] increased damage from you.

nodes.name: Fury Generation
nodes.description: Taking damage while Challenging Shout is active will generate {SF_4} Fury.

nodes.name: Weaken
nodes.description: Challenging Shout Weakens enemies.

nodes.name: Duration Bonus
nodes.description: Challenging Shout's duration is increased by {SF_30} seconds.

nodes.name: Blast
nodes.description:
Death Blow now deals Fire damage and deals an additional {dot:BUFF_UPGRADEC_FIRE_DOT} Burning damage over {buffduration:BUFF_UPGRADEC_FIRE_DOT} seconds.

Enemies that die to Death Blow while Burning or to Death Blow's burn trigger a fiery explosion for {payload:IMPACT_VARIANTC} damage to surrounding enemies.

nodes.name: Execute
nodes.description: Enemies you hit with Death Blow can be Executed by any of your attacks for the next [{SF_35}] seconds, resetting Death Blow's cooldown on a successful Execution{else}making the next cast of Death Blow free.

nodes.name: Overpower
nodes.description: Death Blow grants [{SF_36}] stack of Overpower when it kills an enemy.

nodes.name: Fury Generation
nodes.description: Killing an enemy with Death Blow restores [{SF_37}|%|] of your Fury.

nodes.name: Charges
nodes.description: Death Blow has [{SF_38}+1] charges.{else}Death Blow's Fury cost is reduced to [{SF_23}/2] Fury.

nodes.name: All For One
nodes.description: Casting Rupture Summons [SF_47] Ancients that skewer your target for {payload:INITIAL_DAMAGE} damage and then performing a rip attack that deals {payload:UPGRADEC_RIP_DAMAGE} as direct damage instead of Bleeding.

nodes.name: Size Bonus
nodes.description: Rupture's Size is increased by [{SF_52}*100|%|].

nodes.name: Damage Bonus
nodes.description: Rupture deals [{SF_43}*100|x%|] increased damage. Each subsequent enemy Hit reduces this bonus by [{SF_44}*100|%|].

nodes.name: Cooldown Reduction
nodes.description: Ripping your weapon out of enemies reduces Rupture's Cooldown by {SF_50} second.

nodes.name: Healing
nodes.description: Heal for [{SF_55}*100|%|] of your Maximum Life on Hit.

nodes.name: Mightiest
nodes.description:
Mighty Throw is now an Ultimate Skill that drops a massive weapon for {payload:IMPACT_DAMAGE_CVARIANT} damage with a [{SF_46}] second cooldown.

This cooldown cannot be reduced by Cooldown Reduction.

nodes.name: Solo Chain
nodes.description: Steel Grasp becomes a Basic Skill that has no Cooldown, generates up to {SF_32} Fury based on Charges, but only throws a single chain.

nodes.name: Barrier
nodes.description: Mighty Throw generates up to [{SF_34} * 100|%|] of your Maximum Life ([Max(1,{shield:BARRIER})]) as a Barrier for [{SF_35} ||] seconds.

nodes.name: Size Bonus
nodes.description: Increase Mighty Throw's damage radius by [{SF_54} * 100|%|].

nodes.name: Berserking
nodes.description: Steel Grasp grants Berserking for [{SF_7}] seconds on Hit.

nodes.name: Extra Charges
nodes.description: Steel Grasp gains [{SF_37}] Charges.

nodes.name: Weaken
nodes.description: Steel Grasp Weakens enemies for [{SF_36}] seconds.

nodes.name: Vulnerable
nodes.description: Steel Grasp makes enemies Vulnerable for [{SF_6}] seconds.

nodes.name: Empowered
nodes.description:
Your Ancients are empowered:
Korlic creates an Earthquake that deals {payload:UPGRADEA_EARTHQUAKE_PAYLOAD} Physical damage over [PowerTag.Barbarian_Earthquake."Script Formula 1"] seconds when he leaps.
Talic leaves behind Dust Devils that deal {payload:UPGRADEA_DUSTDEVIL_DMG_TOOLTIP} damage while he whirlwinds.
Madawc ignites the earth, Burning enemies for an additional {dot:UPGRADE_A_UPHEAVAL_FIRE_DOT} damage over {SF_48} seconds when he upheaves the ground.

nodes.name: Highlander
nodes.description: Summon a single, permanent Ancient. Using this skill again replaces it with the next Ancient.

nodes.name: Damage Bonus
nodes.description: You and each of your Ancients summoned from this Skill increase each other's damage by [SF_41 *100|%x|].

nodes.name: Damage Reduction
nodes.description: When you Cast Call of the Ancients, gain [SF_45 * 100|%|] Damage Reduction for each Ancient summoned while they are active.

nodes.name: Ancient Attack Speed
nodes.description: Your Ancients attack [SF_37 * 100|+%|] faster.

nodes.name: Attack Speed and Damage Bonus
nodes.description: When you Cast Call of the Ancients, gain [SF_38 * 100|+%|] Attack Speed and [SF_39 * 100|%x|] increased damage for each Ancient summoned for {buffduration:UPGRADE2_ATTACKSPEED_DAMAGE} seconds.

nodes.name: Hidden Technique
nodes.description: Iron Maelstrom now has {SF_37} Charges and it always uses the same attack that matches your last used weapon at [{SF_23}*100|x%|] increased damage.

nodes.name: Armageddon
nodes.description:
Each attack gains an additional effect:
 Two Handed Bludgeoning creates a Earthquake that deals {payload:UPGRADEA_EARTHQUAKE_TOOLTIP} Physical damage over [PowerTag.Barbarian_Earthquake."Script Formula 1"] seconds,
 Two-Handed Slashing shoots Iron Shrapnel dealing {payload:SHRAPNEL_DAMAGE} damage inflicting {dot:UPGRADE_A_BLEED_DOT} Bleeding damage over {buffduration:UPGRADE_A_BLEED_DOT} seconds
 Dual Wield forms Dust Devils that each deal {payload:UPGRADEA_DUSTDEVIL_DMG_TOOLTIP} damage.

nodes.name: Cooldown Reduction
nodes.description: Weapon swaps reduce the Cooldown of Iron Maelstrom is by {SF_34} second.

nodes.name: Global Cooldown Reduction
nodes.description: Activating Iron Maelstrom reduces all other active Cooldowns by {SF_35} seconds.

nodes.name: Weaken
nodes.description: Enemies damaged by Iron Maelstrom Weakened for [{SF_36}] seconds.

nodes.name: Additional Effect
nodes.description:
Each attack gains an additional effect:
 Two Handed Bludgeoning deals [SF_31 * 100|%x|] increased Critical Strike Damage
 Two Handed Slashing deals [SF_32 * 100|%x|] increased damage to Vulnerable enemies.
 Dual Wield gains [SF_33 * 100|%+|] Cast Speed.

nodes.name: Deep Impact
nodes.description: While Wrath of the Berserker is active, all attacks causes a fiery explosion for {payload:VARIANTB_IMPACT} damage.

nodes.name: Full Throttle
nodes.description: While Wrath of the Berserker is active, you gain a Fire aura that deals {payload:UPGRADE_C_PAYLOAD} damage and Burns for {dot:VARIANT_C_BURNING} damage over {buffduration:VARIANT_C_BURNING} seconds. You gain [SF_39 * 100|%|] All Resistance.

nodes.name: Overpower
nodes.description: Wrath of the Berserker grants {SF_48} stack of Overpower per second.

nodes.name: Duration Bonus
nodes.description: The duration of Wrath of the Berserker is increased to [{SF_43}|1|] seconds.

nodes.name: Berserking
nodes.description: While Wrath of the Berserker is active, your Berserking's base damage bonus is doubled.

nodes.name: Fury Generation
nodes.description: While Wrath of the Berserker is active, gain [SF_31 * 100|%+|] Attack Speed and increase Fury Generation by [SF_32 * 100|%x|].

nodes.name: Ferocity
nodes.description: Grants [{SF_49}] stacks of Ferocity each time you use Mighty Throw.

nodes.name: Overpower
nodes.description: Mighty Throw now consumes one of your Overpower stacks to deal [{SF_50} * 100|x%|] increased damage.

nodes.name: Flurry
nodes.description:
Energy Cost: [SF_21]{else}{Resource Cost}
Lucky Hit Chance: [{Combat Effect Chance}|%|]
Unleash a flurry of stabs and slashes, striking enemies in front of you {SF_2} times and dealing a total of {payload:DAMAGE_TOOLTIP} damage to each.

Combo Points increase damage and grant an Attack Speed bonus for {SF_11} seconds.
 1 Point: {payload:DAMAGE_TOOLTIP_1CP} damage, [{SF_10}*100|%+|] bonus
 2 Points: {payload:DAMAGE_TOOLTIP_2CP} damage, [2*{SF_10}*100|%+|] bonus
 3 Points: {payload:DAMAGE_TOOLTIP_3CP} damage, [3*{SF_10}*100|%+|] bonus

nodes.name: Heartseeker
Blade Shift
Procession
nodes.description: Heartseeker now has a [{SF_13}*100|%|] chance to fire an additional arrow. When Heartseeker Critically Strikes, it grants {SF_42} stack of Overpower.

nodes.name: Vehemence
nodes.description: Flurry's size is increased by [{SF_52}|x%|] and its Energy Cost is reduced to {SF_36}. Flurry now also gains [{SF_53}*100|x%|] increased damage each time it hits an enemy, up to [{SF_53}*{SF_54}*100|x%|], for {buffduration:UPGRADE_C_BONUS} seconds.

nodes.name: Explosive Shot
nodes.description:
Rapid Fire is also a Grenade Skill.

Rapid Fire fires arrows tipped with grenades, causing them to no longer ricochet and instead explode, dealing {payload:UPGRADE_B_IMPACT} damage.

nodes.name: Smoke Grenade
nodes.description:
Energy Cost: {Resource Cost}
Charges: {SF_44}
Charge Cooldown: {Recharge Time} seconds
Cooldown: {Cooldown Time} seconds
Lucky Hit Chance: [{Combat Effect Chance}|%|]
Throw a smoky concoction at enemies that deals {payload:SMOKE_PAYLOAD} damage and Dazes them for {buffduration:SMOKE_BLINDNESS} seconds.

Combo Points increase damage and Shade damage.
 1 Point: {payload:UPGRADE_C_PAYLOAD_1CP} damage, {payload:UPGRADE_C_PAYLOAD_SHADE_1CP} Shade damage
 2 Points: {payload:UPGRADE_C_PAYLOAD_2CP} damage, {payload:UPGRADE_C_PAYLOAD_SHADE_2CP} Shade damage
 3 Points: {payload:UPGRADE_C_PAYLOAD_3CP} damage, {payload:UPGRADE_C_PAYLOAD_SHADE_3CP} Shade damage

nodes.name: Barrage
nodes.description:
Energy Cost: {Resource Cost}
Lucky Hit Chance: [{Combat Effect Chance}|%|]
Unleash a barrage of {SF_5} arrows that expands outwards, each dealing {payload:IMPACT} damage and piercing up to {SF_8} times. Arrows cannot hit the same target more than once.

Combo Points increase damage and arrows fired:
 1 Point: {payload:DAMAGE_TOOLTIP_1CP} damage, [Floor({SF_5}+{SF_12}*{SF_22})] arrows
 2 Points: {payload:DAMAGE_TOOLTIP_2CP} damage, [Floor({SF_5}+{SF_12}*2*{SF_22})] arrows
 3 Points: {payload:DAMAGE_TOOLTIP_3CP} damage, [Floor({SF_5}+{SF_12}*3*{SF_22})] arrows

nodes.name: Caltrops
nodes.description:
Charges: {SF_9}
Charge Cooldown: {Recharge Time} seconds
Lucky Hit Chance: [{Combat Effect Chance}|%|]
Throw caltrops on the ground, dealing {payload:IMPACT} damage. Affected enemies take {payload:IMPACT_OVER_TIME} damage every second and are Slowed by [{SF_1}*100|%|]. Lasts {SF_0} seconds.

nodes.name: Invigorating Strike
Grenade Shift
nodes.description: Blade Shift now deals {payload:UPGRADEB_IMPACT} damage and while Unhindered by Blade Shift, you drop {SF_26} Stun Grenades that each deal {payload:UPGRADEB_GRENADES_TOOLTIP} damage on the enemies you pass through.

nodes.name: Mired Sharpshooter
nodes.description: Caltrops no longer Slows enemies and instead is also a Marksman Skill that throws [SF_33] piercing daggers over its duration, each dealing {payload:UPGRADE_B_DAMAGE} Shadow damage. Enemies damaged by Caltrops become Vulnerable for [SF_31] seconds.

nodes.name: Accumulating Strike
nodes.description: Invigorating Strike now deals {payload:UPGRADEA_IMPACT} damage and every [SF_31]rd cast grants [SF_30] stack of Resolve and [SF_29] stack of Ferocity.

nodes.name: Encircling Blades
nodes.description: Flurry now damages enemies in a circle around you and deals {payload:DAMAGE_A_TOOLTIP} damage.

nodes.name: Multishot
nodes.description: Barrage deals {payload:UPGRADE_A_IMPACT} damage and fires [SF_25] additional arrows and all of its arrows now travel faster and pierce through [SF_51] additional enemies.

nodes.name: Shadow Step
nodes.description:
Charges: {SF_21}
Charge Cooldown: {Recharge Time} seconds
Cooldown: {Cooldown Time} seconds
Lucky Hit Chance: [{Combat Effect Chance}|%|]
Quickly move through the shadows to stab your victim from behind for {payload:MELEE_PAYLOAD} damage and Execute them. Gain [{SF_5}*100|%|] increased Movement Speed for {buffduration:BONUS_MOVE_SPEED} seconds afterwards.

nodes.name: Safe Arrival
nodes.description: Shadow Step Dazes its primary target for {buffduration:UPGRADE_B_DAZE} seconds and leaves {SF_27} Stun Grenades at its feet that each deal {payload:UPGRADE_B_GRENADES_TOOLTIP} damage.

nodes.name: Cold Imbuement
nodes.description:
Cooldown: {Cooldown Time} seconds
Lucky Hit Chance: [{Combat_Effect_Chance_Script_Formula_Override:6}|%|]
Imbue your weapons with frigid energies for {buffduration:ICE_CHARGES} seconds. While imbued, your Imbueable Skills deal Cold damage, Chill enemies for [{SF_3}|%|] per hit, and Weaken enemies for [{SF_5}] seconds.

nodes.name: Penetrating Shot
nodes.description:
Energy Cost: {Resource Cost}
Lucky Hit Chance: {Combat Effect Chance}%
Fire an arrow that pierces through all enemies in a line, dealing {payload:IMPACT} damage.

Combo Points increase damage and improve Lucky Hit Chance:
 1 Point: {payload:DAMAGE_TOOLTIP_1CP} damage, [{SF_15}*{SF_10}|%+|] chance
 2 Points: {payload:DAMAGE_TOOLTIP_2CP} damage, [{SF_15}*{SF_10}*2|%+|] chance
 3 Points: {payload:DAMAGE_TOOLTIP_3CP} damage, [{SF_15}*{SF_10}*3|%+|] chance

nodes.name: Poison Imbuement
nodes.description:
Cooldown: {Cooldown Time} seconds
Lucky Hit Chance: [{Combat_Effect_Chance_Script_Formula_Override:17}|%|]
Imbue your weapons with lethal poison for {buffduration:POISON_CHARGES} seconds. While imbued, your Imbueable Skills deal Poison damage and apply [{SF_6}*100/{SF_7}*{SF_2}|%|] of their Base damage as additional Poisoning damage over {buffduration:POISON_DOT} seconds.

nodes.name: Puncture
nodes.description:
Energy Cost: {Resource Cost}
Generate Combo Point: 1
Lucky Hit Chance: [{Combat Effect Chance}|%|]
Throw blades a short distance, dealing {payload:IMPACT} damage.

nodes.name: Dark Shroud
nodes.description:
Cooldown: {Cooldown Time} seconds
Surround yourself with up to {SF_0} protective shadows. Gain [{SF_1} * 100|1+%|] Resistance to All Elements per active shadow. If you have the maximum amount of shadows, direct damage is reduced by [{SF_22} * 100|1%|]. Each time you take direct damage, a shadow is consumed.

nodes.name: Propulsion
nodes.description: Puncture now deals {payload:UPGRADEA_IMPACT} damage and every {SF_20}rd Puncture will also ricochet up to [SF_35] times. Hits against Slowed enemies will always ricochet.

nodes.name: Best Served Cold
nodes.description: When a Dark Shroud shadow is consumed, it explodes in a frigid nova that deals {payload:COLD_EXPLOSION_TOOLTIP} Cold damage to surrounding enemies and Chills them for [{SF_17}|%|].

nodes.name: Poison Trap
nodes.description:
Charges: {SF_49}
Charge Cooldown: {Recharge Time} seconds
Cooldown: {Cooldown Time} seconds
Lucky Hit Chance: [{Combat_Effect_Chance_Script_Formula_Override:1}|%|]
Place a trap that arms after {buffduration:ARMING} seconds. It activates when an enemy moves within range, applying {payload:TOOLTIP_DAMAGE} Poisoning damage over {SF_2} seconds to enemies in the area.

You can have {SF_10} armed traps out at once.

nodes.name: Sight Unseen
nodes.description: Shadow Step has an additional Charge and refunds a Charge when it kills an enemy. Casting Shadow Step increases its damage by [SF_36 * 100|%x|] for [SF_37] seconds, up to [SF_36 * SF_38 *100|%x|].

nodes.name: Frozen Heart
nodes.description: Cold Imbued Skills cause enemies to become Vulnerable for [{SF_22}] seconds. Cold Imbuement's Duration is increased by [{SF_8}*100|x%|].

nodes.name: Infiltrator
nodes.description: Poison Trap's Cooldown is reduced by [SF_44|1|] seconds. Poison Trap has no arm time, no longer breaks Stealth, and triggers no Cooldown while you are in Stealth. All Poison Traps activate when you exit Stealth and begin Poison Trap's Cooldown.

nodes.name: Broadside
nodes.description: Barrage no longer pierces and fires {SF_45} less arrows. Its arrows each drop {SF_27} Stun Grenade that deals {payload:UPGRADE_B_STUN_GRENADE_TOOLTIP} damage.

nodes.name: Twisting Blades
nodes.description:
Energy Cost: {Resource Cost}
Lucky Hit Chance: [{Combat Effect Chance}|%|]
Impale an enemy with your blades, dealing {payload:IMPACT} damage. After {buffduration:RETURN_TIMER} seconds the blades return to you, piercing enemies for {payload:RETURN_HIT} damage.

Combo Points increase damage and and improve Lucky Hit Chance:
 1 Point: {payload:DAMAGE_TOOLTIP_1CP} damage, [{SF_23}*{SF_34}|%+|] chance
 2 Points: {payload:DAMAGE_TOOLTIP_2CP} damage, [{SF_23}*{SF_34}*2|%+|] chance
 3 Points: {payload:DAMAGE_TOOLTIP_3CP} damage, [{SF_23}*{SF_34}*3|%+|] chance

nodes.name: Overflow
nodes.description: Dark Shroud no longer grants Resistance to All Elements, but instead grants you [SF_20*100|x%|] increased Energy Regeneration per shadow.

nodes.name: Sapper
nodes.description:
Lucky Hit: Poison Imbued Skills have up to a [{SF_21}*100|%|] chance to Fortify you [{SF_39}*100|1%|] of your Maximum Life.

While imbued, your Fortify heals you [{SF_40}*100|%|] faster.

nodes.name: Bladedancer
nodes.description: Twisting Blades now cleaves and spirals outward around you for a short time after they return, dealing {payload:ORBIT_HIT} damage per hit.

nodes.name: Detonation
nodes.description: Dash is also a Grenade Skill. At the end of Dash, explode and Knock Down surrounding enemies for {SF_12} seconds, dealing {payload:MOD_B_IMPACT} damage to them.

nodes.name: Dash
nodes.description:
Charges: {SF_22}
Charge Cooldown: {Recharge Time} seconds
Lucky Hit Chance: [{Combat Effect Chance}|%|]
Dash forward and slash enemies for {payload:IMPACT} damage. Any enemies hit are Slowed by [{SF_19}* 100|%|] for {buffduration:SLOW} seconds.

nodes.name: Dark Dance
nodes.description: Evading through an enemy infected by Shadow Imbuement grants Stealth for {SF_33} seconds and explodes the infection for [{SF_34} * 100|x%|] increased damage.

nodes.name: Shadow Imbuement
nodes.description:
Cooldown: {Cooldown Time} seconds
Lucky Hit Chance: [{Combat Effect Chance}|%|]
Imbue your weapons with festering shadows for {buffduration:SHADOW_CHARGES} seconds. While imbued, your Imbueable Skills deal Shadow damage and infect enemies for {SF_2} seconds. Infected enemies explode on death, dealing {payload:DEATH_AOE} damage to all surrounding enemies.

If the infection expires before the enemy dies, it will deal {payload:EXPIRATION_FIZZLE} damage to only that enemy.

nodes.name: Shadow Shot
nodes.description: Penetrating Shot now summons [SF_40] Shades that also fire at your target, each dealing {payload:UPGRADEB_IMPACT_SHADE} damage.

nodes.name: Catch Cold
nodes.description: Caltrops now deals Cold damage and Chills enemies for {SF_16}% per second.

nodes.name: Forceful Arrow
Cloudburst
nodes.description: Forceful Arrow's Propel no longer Knocks Back Close enemies and instead creates an Arrow Storm every {SF_31} arrows, dealing {payload:UPGRADE_C_DAMAGE_TOOLTIP} damage and Slowing enemies hit by [{SF_21}*100|%|] for {buffduration:SLOW} seconds.

nodes.name: Primer
nodes.description: At the end of Dash, you enter Stealth for [SF_36] seconds and gain [SF_37] stack of Ferocity, increased by [{SF_42}] per {SF_45} Skill Ranks.

nodes.name: Rain of Arrows
nodes.description:
Cooldown: {Cooldown Time} seconds
Lucky Hit Chance: [{Combat Effect Chance}|%|]
Arrows rain down over a large area dealing {payload:TOOLTIP_DAMAGE} damage and Immobilizing enemies for [SF_19] seconds.

nodes.name: Shadow Clone
nodes.description:
Charges: {SF_42}
Charge Cooldown: {SF_42} per {Recharge Time} seconds
{else}Cooldown: {Cooldown Time} seconds
Lucky Hit Chance: [{SF_43}|%|]
{else}Summon a shadow that mimics your actions for {SF_0} seconds. This Shadow Clone deals [{SF_1}*100|%|] of your damage.

nodes.name: Death Trap
nodes.description:
Cooldown: {Recharge Time} seconds{else}Cooldown: {Cooldown Time} seconds
Lucky Hit Chance: [{Combat Effect Chance}|%|]
Place a trap that arms after {buffduration:ARMING} seconds. It activates once an enemy is within range, dealing a total of {payload:TOOLTIP_DAMAGE} damage in the area.

nodes.name: Awakening
nodes.description:
Passive: After spending {SF_30} Energy, your next Core Skill Cast becomes a Shade Skill and spawns a Shade that deals [{SF_29}*100|%|] of its damage.

Shadow Clone is now also a Shade Skill and its duration is reduced by [{SF_31}*100|%x|].

nodes.name: Sentry
nodes.description:
Shadow Clone becomes a Marksman Skill and now summons a stationary shadow that fires {SF_21} piercing arrows every [{SF_19}|1|] seconds. Each arrow deals {payload:UPGRADE_C_PROJECTILE_PAYLOAD} damage.

Shadow Clone gains {SF_39} additional Charges, and its Cooldown is reduced by {SF_40} seconds. You may have up to [SF_8] Shadow Clones active at a time.

nodes.name: Death Pit
nodes.description:
Death Trap Pulls In enemies and makes them Vulnerable and Knocked Down for {SF_38} seconds.

Death Trap gains {SF_36} additional charge and has its Cooldown reduced by {SF_37} seconds.

nodes.name: Rapid Fire
nodes.description:
Energy Cost: {Resource Cost}
Lucky Hit Chance: [{Combat Effect Chance}|%|]
Rapidly fire {SF_5} arrows, each dealing {payload:IMPACT} damage and ricocheting {SF_36} times.

Combo Points increase damage and arrows fired:
 1 Point: {payload:DAMAGE_TOOLTIP_1CP} damage, [Floor({SF_5}+{SF_12}*{SF_22})] arrows
 2 Points: {payload:DAMAGE_TOOLTIP_2CP} damage, [Floor({SF_5}+{SF_12}*2*{SF_22})] arrows
 3 Points: {payload:DAMAGE_TOOLTIP_3CP} damage, [Floor({SF_5}+{SF_12}*3*{SF_22})] arrows

nodes.name: Frostbite Trap
nodes.description: Poison Trap no longer deals Poisoning damage and instead deals {payload:UPGRADEC_TOOLTIP_DAMAGE} Frostbite damage and Chills enemies for [{SF_43}|%|] per second.

nodes.name: Three of a Kind
nodes.description:
Puncture becomes a Cutthroat Skill.

Puncture now throws 3 blades in a spread, each dealing [{SF_21} * 100|%|] of its Base damage. Hitting an enemy with all 3 blades at once makes them Vulnerable for {SF_18} seconds.

nodes.name: Pin
nodes.description: Forceful Arrow now Immobilizes Knocked Back enemies for {buffduration:IMMOBILIZE} |4second:seconds; and deals {payload:UPGRADE_A_IMPACT} damage. Forceful Arrow's Knock Back range is increased by [{SF_28}*100|%|].

nodes.name: Quick Strike
nodes.description:
Invigorating Strike is also a Mobility Skill.

Casting Invigorating Strike now dashes you to the target, dealing {payload:UPGRADEB_IMPACT} damage and granting [{SF_15}*100|%x|] increased Movement Speed for {buffduration:UPGRADEB_MOVEMENT_SPEED_BONUS} seconds.

nodes.name: Devouring Arrow
nodes.description: Heartseeker now pierces up to [SF_31] additional time and deals [SF_36 * 100|%x|] increased damage against the enemy it hits for the next {buffduration:UPGRADEB_DAMAGE_BONUS} seconds, up to [SF_36 * SF_38 * 100|%x|].

nodes.name: Impossible Escape
nodes.description: Blade Shift now deals {payload:UPGRADEC_IMPACT} Shadow damage and moving through an enemy while Unhindered by Blade Shift automatically attacks that enemy with Blade Shift.

nodes.name: Breakneck Quiver
nodes.description: Rapid Fire gains [{SF_37}*100|+%|] increased Cast Speed, and its Energy Cost is reduced to {SF_38}.

nodes.name: Sleight of Hand
nodes.description: Enemies impaled by Twisting Blades are Dazed. When your Twisting Blades return, your active Cooldowns are reduced by [{SF_19}|2|] seconds per enemy they passed through, up to [{SF_16}] seconds. Twisting Blades damage is increased by [{SF_40}*100|x%|].

nodes.name: Silhouette
nodes.description: Smoke Grenade no longer Dazes enemies and instead creates a cloud of shadows at your feet. While within the cloud, you gain [{SF_39}*100|+1%|] Critical Strike Chance and Stealth once every [{SF_50}] second.

nodes.name: Poison Grenade

nodes.description: Incinerate gains a [SF_23 * 100|%|] chance to deal double damage while you have a stack of Overpower.

nodes.description: Fireball travels [SF_19*100|%|] faster and deals [SF_20*100|%x|] increased damage.

nodes.description: When Frozen Orb first explodes it remains stationary for [SF_46|1|] seconds then seeks another target to explode again, dealing {payload:UPGRADEA_2ND_IMPACT_DAMAGE} damage.
